original: あいつは何かと言うと知ったかぶりをする。

en.text: Regardless of the subject, he pretends to know all about it.

indices: 彼奴(あいつ)[01]{あいつ} は 何かと言うと 知ったか振り{知ったかぶり} を 為る(する)[01]{する}

original: 知ったかぶりすんなよ。

en.text: Don't act like you know everything.

original: あいつはただの知ったかぶりだよ。

en.text: That person is just making themselves out to be smarter than they actually are.

original: すぐ知ったかぶりをするんだから。

en.text: The reason is they immediately pretend to know.
The reason is they are frankly know-it-alls.
The reason is they immediately say things off the top of their heads.
The reason is they immediately wing it.

indices: 直ぐ{すぐ} 知ったか振り{知ったかぶり} を 為る(する)[01]{する} ん[04] だから
